wp_pk_payment_orders.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `wp_pk_payment_orders` (
  `id` INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  `property_id` INTEGER NOT NULL,
  `owner_id` INTEGER NOT NULL,
  `provider` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unselected',
  `provider_order_ref` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE,
  `amount_minor` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `currency` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MAD',
  `purpose` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL DEFAULT 'premium_visibility',
  `status` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL DEFAULT 'disabled',
  `metadata` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE,
  `created_at` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL
) STRICT

wp_pk_premium_subscriptions.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `wp_pk_premium_subscriptions` (
  `id` INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  `property_id` INTEGER NOT NULL,
  `owner_id` INTEGER NOT NULL,
  `payment_order_id` INTEGER,
  `plan_key` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL DEFAULT 'premium_visibility',
  `status` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL DEFAULT 'disabled',
  `starts_at` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE,
  `ends_at` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE,
  `created_at` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL
) STRICT

wp_pk_premium_history.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `wp_pk_premium_history` (
  `id` INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  `property_id` INTEGER NOT NULL,
  `owner_id` INTEGER NOT NULL,
  `status` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL,
  `selection_reason` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL,
  `granted_by` INTEGER NOT NULL,
  `granted_at` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL,
  `starts_at` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL,
  `ends_at` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE NOT NULL,
  `revoked_by` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `revoked_at` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE,
  `revocation_reason` TEXT COLLATE NOCASE
) STRICT
